verses.en: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whom the LORD put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD had commanded.
verses.pt: Assim trabalharão Bezaleel e Aoliabe, e todo homem hábil, a quem o Senhor deu sabedoria e entendimento, para saberem exercer todo ofício para o serviço do santuário, conforme tudo o que o Senhor tem ordenado.
verses.en_web: “Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man, in whom Yahweh has put wisdom and understanding to know how to do all the work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that Yahweh has commanded.”
verses.en_bbe: So let Bezalel and Oholiab get to work, with every wise-hearted man to whom the Lord has given wisdom and knowledge, to do whatever is necessary for the ordering of the holy place, as the Lord has given orders.

verses.en: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it:
verses.pt: Então Moisés chamou a Bezaleel e a Aoliabe, e a todo homem hábil, em cujo coração Deus tinha posto sabedoria, isto é, a todo aquele cujo coração o moveu a se chegar à obra para fazê-la;
verses.en_web: Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whose heart Yahweh had put wisdom, even everyone whose heart stirred him up to come to the work to do it:
verses.en_bbe: Then Moses sent for Bezalel and Oholiab, and for all the wise-hearted men to whom the Lord had given wisdom, even everyone who was moved by the impulse of his heart to come and take part in the work:

verses.en: And they received of Moses all the offering, which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to make it withal. And they brought yet unto him free offerings every morning.
verses.pt: e receberam de Moisés toda a oferta alçada, que os filhos de Israel tinham do para a obra do serviço do santuário, para fazê-la; e ainda eles lhe traziam cada manhã ofertas voluntárias.
verses.en_web: and they received from Moses all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, with which to make it. They brought yet to him freewill offerings every morning.
verses.en_bbe: And they took from Moses all the offerings which the children of Israel had given for the building of the holy place. And still they went on giving him more free offerings every morning.

verses.en: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they made;
verses.pt: Então todos os sábios que faziam toda a obra do santuário vieram, cada um da obra que fazia,
verses.en_web: All the wise men, who performed all the work of the sanctuary, each came from his work which they did.
verses.en_bbe: Then the wise men, who were doing all the work of the holy place, came from their work;

verses.en: And they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which the LORD commanded to make.
verses.pt: e disseram a Moisés: O povo traz muito mais do que é necessário para o serviço da obra que o Senhor ordenou se fizesse.
verses.en_web: They spoke to Moses, saying, “The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work which Yahweh commanded to make.”
verses.en_bbe: And said to Moses, The people are giving much more than is needed for the work which the Lord has given us orders to do.

verses.en: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.
verses.pt: Pelo que Moisés deu ordem, a qual fizeram proclamar por todo o arraial, dizendo: Nenhum homem, nem mulher, faça mais obra alguma para a oferta alçada do santuário. Assim o povo foi proibido de trazer mais.
verses.en_web: Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, “Let neither man nor woman make anything else for the offering for the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing.
verses.en_bbe: So Moses made an order and had it given out through all the tents, saying, Let no man or woman make any more offerings for the holy place. So the people were kept from giving more.

verses.en: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much.
verses.pt: Porque o material que tinham era bastante para toda a obra, e ainda sobejava.
verses.en_web: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much.
verses.en_bbe: For the material they had was enough and more than enough for all the work which had to be done.

verses.en: And every wise hearted man among them that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work made he them.
verses.pt: Assim todos os homens hábeis, dentre os que trabalhavam na obra, fizeram o tabernáculo de dez cortinas de linho fino torcido, de azul, de púrpura e de carmesim, com querubins, obra de artífice.
verses.en_web: All the wise-hearted men among those who did the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains; of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet, with cherubim, the work of the skillful workman, they made them.
verses.en_bbe: Then all the expert workmen among them made the House with its ten curtains; of the best linen, blue and purple and red, they made them, with winged ones worked by expert designers.

verses.en: The length of one curtain was twenty and eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: the curtains were all of one size.
verses.pt: O comprimento de cada cortina era de vinte e oito côvados, e a largura de quatro côvados; todas as cortinas eram da mesma medida.
verses.en_web: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits. All the curtains had one measure.
verses.en_bbe: Every curtain was twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide, all of the same measure.

verses.en: And he coupled the five curtains one unto another: and the other five curtains he coupled one unto another.
verses.pt: Ligaram cinco cortinas uma com outra; e as outras cinco da mesma maneira.
verses.en_web: He coupled five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he coupled to one another.
verses.en_bbe: And five curtains were joined together, and the other five curtains were joined together.

verses.en: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling: likewise he made in the uttermost side of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.
verses.pt: Fizeram laçadas de azul na orla da última cortina do primeiro grupo; assim, também fizeram na orla da primeira cortina do segundo grupo.
verses.en_web: He made loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling. Likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second coupling.
verses.en_bbe: And they put twists of blue cord on the edge of the outside curtain of the first group, and in the same way on the outside curtain of the second group.

verses.en: Fifty loops made he in one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which was in the coupling of the second: the loops held one curtain to another.
verses.pt: Cinqüenta laçadas fizeram na orla de uma cortina, e cinquenta laçadas na orla da outra, do segundo grupo; as laçadas eram contrapostas uma à outra.
verses.en_web: He made fifty loops in the one curtain, and he made fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that was in the second coupling. The loops were opposite to one another.
verses.en_bbe: Fifty twists on the one curtain and fifty on the edge of the curtain of the other group; the twists being opposite to one another.

verses.en: And he made fifty taches of gold, and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches: so it became one tabernacle.
verses.pt: Também fizeram cinqüenta colchetes de ouro, e com estes colchetes uniram as cortinas, uma com outra; e o tabernáculo veio a ser um todo.
verses.en_web: He made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains to one another with the clasps: so the tabernacle was a unit.
verses.en_bbe: And they made fifty hooks of gold, joining the curtains one to another with the hooks; and so the House was made.

verses.en: And he made curtains of goats’ hair for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.
verses.pt: Fizeram também cortinas de pelos de cabras para servirem de tenda sobre o tabernáculo; onze cortinas fizeram.
verses.en_web: He made curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. He made them eleven curtains.
verses.en_bbe: And they made curtains of goats' hair for the tent; eleven curtains were made.

verses.en: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits was the breadth of one curtain: the eleven curtains were of one size.
verses.pt: O comprimento de cada cortina era de trinta côvados, e a largura de quatro côvados; as onze cortinas eram da mesma medida.
verses.en_web: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the width of each curtain. The eleven curtains had one measure.
verses.en_bbe: Every curtain was thirty cubits long and four cubits wide, all of the same measure.

verses.en: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
verses.pt: uniram cinco destas cortinas à parte, e as outras seis à parte.
verses.en_web: He coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
verses.en_bbe: Five curtains were joined together to make one group, and six curtains were joined together to make the other group.

verses.en: And he made fifty loops upon the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.
verses.pt: Fizeram cinqüenta laçadas na orla da última cortina do primeiro grupo, e cinqüenta laçadas na orla da primeira cortina do segundo grupo.
verses.en_web: He made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the coupling, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which was outermost in the second coupling.
verses.en_bbe: And they put fifty twists of cord on the edge of the outside curtain of the first group, and fifty twists on the edge of the outside curtain of the second group,

verses.en: And he made fifty taches of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.
verses.pt: Fizeram também cinqüenta colchetes de bronze, para ajuntar a tenda, para que viesse a ser um todo.
verses.en_web: He made fifty clasps of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be a unit.
verses.en_bbe: And fifty hooks of brass for joining them together to make the tent.

verses.en: And he made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of badgers’ skins above that.
verses.pt: Fizeram para a tenda uma cobertura de peles de carneiros tintas de vermelho, e por cima desta uma cobertura de peles de golfinhos.
verses.en_web: He made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.
verses.en_bbe: And they made a cover of sheepskins coloured red, to go over the tent, and a cover of leather over that.

verses.en: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood, standing up.
verses.pt: Também fizeram, de madeira de acácia, as tábuas para o tabernáculo, as quais foram colocadas verticalmente.
verses.en_web: He made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.
verses.en_bbe: And for the uprights of the House they made boards of hard wood.

verses.en: The length of a board was ten cubits, and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half.
verses.pt: O comprimento de cada tábua era de dez côvados, e a largura de um côvado e meio.
verses.en_web: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the width of each board.
verses.en_bbe: The boards were ten cubits long and one cubit and a half wide.

verses.en: One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
verses.pt: Cada tábua tinha duas couceiras, unidas uma à outra; assim fizeram com todas as tábuas do tabernáculo.
verses.en_web: Each board had two tenons, joined to one another. He made all the boards of the tabernacle this way.
verses.en_bbe: Every board had two tongues fixed into it; all the boards were made in this way.

verses.en: And he made boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward:
verses.pt: Assim, pois, fizeram as tábuas para o tabernáculo; vinte tábuas para o lado que dá para o sul;
verses.en_web: He made the boards for the tabernacle: twenty boards for the south side southward.
verses.en_bbe: They made twenty boards for the south side of the House:

verses.en: And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.
verses.pt: e fizeram quarenta bases de prata para se pôr debaixo das vinte tábuas: duas bases debaixo de uma tábua para as suas duas couceiras, e duas debaixo de outra, para as duas couceiras dela.
verses.en_web: He made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.
verses.en_bbe: And for these twenty boards, forty silver bases, two bases under every board, to take its tongues.

verses.en: And for the other side of the tabernacle, which is toward the north corner, he made twenty boards,
verses.pt: Também para o segundo lado do tabernáculo, o que dá para o norte, fizeram vinte tábuas,
verses.en_web: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards,
verses.en_bbe: And for the second side of the House, on the north, they made twenty boards,

verses.en: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.pt: com as suas quarenta bases de prata, duas bases debaixo de uma tábua, e duas bases debaixo de outra.
verses.en_web: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.en_bbe: With their forty silver bases, two bases for every board.

verses.en: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.
verses.pt: Para o lado posterior do tabernáculo, o que dá para o ocidente, fizeram seis tábuas.
verses.en_web: For the far part of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.
verses.en_bbe: And for the west side of the House, at the back, they made six boards,

verses.en: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
verses.pt: E para os dois cantos do tabernáculo no lado posterior, fizeram mais duas tábuas.
verses.en_web: He made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part.
verses.en_bbe: And two boards for the angles at the back.

verses.en: And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at the head thereof, to one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners.
verses.pt: Por baixo eram duplas, do mesmo modo se estendendo até a primeira argola, em cima; assim fizeram com as duas tábuas nos dois cantos.
verses.en_web: They were double beneath, and in the same way they were all the way to its top to one ring. He did this to both of them in the two corners.
verses.en_bbe: These were joined together at the base and at the top to one ring, so forming the two angles.

verses.en: And there were eight boards; and their sockets were sixteen sockets of silver, under every board two sockets.
verses.pt: Assim havia oito tábuas com as suas bases de prata, a saber, dezesseis bases, duas debaixo de cada tábua.
verses.en_web: There were eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; under every board two sockets.
verses.en_bbe: So there were eight boards with sixteen bases of silver, two bases under every board.

verses.en: And he made bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.pt: Fizeram também travessões de madeira de acácia: cinco travessões para as tábuas de um lado do tabernáculo,
verses.en_web: He made bars of acacia wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.en_bbe: And they made rods of hard wood; five for the boards on one side of the House,

verses.en: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward.
verses.pt: e cinco para as tábuas do outro lado do tabernáculo, e outros cinco para as tábuas do tabernáculo no lado posterior, o que dá para o ocidente.
verses.en_web: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward.
verses.en_bbe: And five for the boards on the other side of the House, and five for the boards at the back, on the west.

verses.en: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.
verses.pt: Fizeram que o travessão do meio passasse ao meio das tábuas duma extremidade até a outra.
verses.en_web: He made the middle bar to pass through in the middle of the boards from the one end to the other.
verses.en_bbe: The middle rod was made to go right through the rings of all the boards from one end to the other.

verses.en: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
verses.pt: E cobriram as tábuas de ouro, e de ouro fizeram as suas argolas como lugares para os travessoes; também os travessões cobriu de ouro.
verses.en_web: He overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold as places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
verses.en_bbe: All the boards were plated with gold, and the rings through which the rods went were of gold, and the rods were plated with gold.

verses.en: And he made a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubims made he it of cunning work.
verses.pt: Fizeram então o véu de azul, púrpura, carmesim e linho fino torcido; com querubins, obra de artífice, o fizeram.
verses.en_web: He made the veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubim. He made it the work of a skillful workman.
verses.en_bbe: And he made the veil of the best linen, blue and purple and red, worked with winged ones designed by expert workmen.

verses.en: And he made thereunto four pillars of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold: their hooks were of gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.
verses.pt: E fizeram-lhe quatro colunas de madeira de acácia e as cobriram de ouro; e seus colchetes fizeram de ouro; e fundiram-lhes quatro bases de prata.
verses.en_web: He made four pillars of acacia for it, and overlaid them with gold. Their hooks were of gold. He cast four sockets of silver for them.
verses.en_bbe: And they made four pillars for it of hard wood plated with gold: they had hooks of gold and four silver bases.

verses.en: And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of needlework;
verses.pt: Fizeram também para a porta da tenda um reposteiro de azul, púrpura, carmesim e linho fino torcido, obra de bordador,
verses.en_web: He made a screen for the door of the tent, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer;
verses.en_bbe: And they made a curtain for the door of the tent, of the best linen with needlework of blue and purple and red;

verses.en: And the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold: but their five sockets were of brass.
verses.pt: com as suas cinco colunas e os seus colchetes; e de ouro cobriu os seus capitéis e as suas faixas; e as suas cinco bases eram de bronze.
verses.en_web: and the five pillars of it with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold, and their five sockets were of brass.
verses.en_bbe: And five pillars for the curtain, with their hooks; the heads of the pillars were of gold and they were circled with bands of gold; and their five bases were of brass.
